name: spall_read
title: Read a note
description: Reads a note and its rev. view=markdown (default) returns the text; view=outline returns headings, block ids and frontmatter keys without the body (a cheap way to get the rev); view=frontmatter returns properties and tags; view=section returns one heading's section. Long notes are cut at max_chars.

path.description: Note path relative to your root; ".md" optional

heading.description: For view=section: heading path like "Notes > Highlights"

index.description: For view=section: which match, when the heading is ambiguous
